label: nyiso 78 oil daily
definition: (PROBE — attribution arm) nyiso-76 P2 ALONE: the daily-resolution dual-fuel oil-parity cap without the ORDC step-span fix. The measured EIA-923 monthly delivered petroleum receipt is shaped mean-preservingly by the measured EIA daily NY Harbor ULSD spot (data/raw/oil-prices/ny_harbor_ulsd_daily.csv), so the cap is no longer a flat monthly plateau while the gas side of the same min() is already daily. Mechanism fires as designed — 320 gas tranches / 16.5 GW capped, Jan-2025 polar-vortex days lift the cap +5.8% and the mild first week falls -5.1%, per-month means preserved to 1e-12. NEGATIVE RESULT: the whole effect is ~+$0.10/MWh on the 2025 annual mean, because distillate is a globally-traded commodity whose intra-month swing is only +/-5% — it does not spike on a New York cold day the way Transco Z6 NY gas does ($97.9/MMBtu on 2025-01-17). The flat oil-parity cap is NOT the winter root cause the overrun/underrun handoff proposed; that candidate is closed. See docs/FINDING-nyiso-ordc-span-reliability-floor-2026-07-26.md §2.
